results.numbering_finding: ClinVar/RefSeq NM_000454.5 numbers the initiator Met as residue 1, so mature-protein A4V = transcript p.Ala5Val. This independently confirms the precursor-vs-mature numbering offset documented in our SOD1 study (FireProtDB precursor numbering vs PDB mature numbering) - the same offset that silently corrupts ddG rows if unchecked.
